item.label: Type
item.description: Choose which type of products you would like to display.

item.label: Related Products
item.description: Only include products for the current page. Useful on archive and index pages. For example let's say you used this module on a Theme Builder layout that is enabled for product categories. Selecting the "Sale Products" view type above and enabling this option would show only products that are on sale when viewing product categories.

item.label: Current Page
item.description: Only include products for the current page. Useful on archive and index pages. For example let's say you used this module on a Theme Builder layout that is enabled for product categories. Selecting the "Sale Products" view type above and enabling this option would show only products that are on sale when viewing product categories.

item.label: Product Count
item.description: Define the number of products that should be displayed per page.

item.label: Order By
item.description: Choose how your products should be ordered.

date.label: Sort By Date: Oldest To Newest

date-desc.label: Sort By Date: Newest To Oldest

price.label: Sort By Price: Low To High

price-desc.label: Sort By Price: High To Low

item.label: Show result Count
item.description: Turn Pagination result Count on and off.

item.label: Show sorting
item.description: Turn Pagination sorting on and off.

item.label: Show Badge In Image Container
item.description: Turn Badge In Image on and off.

item.label: After Badge Text Enable
item.description: After Badge Turn on and off.

item.label: After Badge Text Type
item.description: Choose how your after Badge Text Type.
